guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：電波陣列相關器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Radio-array correlators
guides.concept: 以 ALMA 的 64 天線基線相關器與 VLA 的 WIDAR 相關器為參照，說明可見度如何由兩天線電壓的互相關產生、幾何延遲與條紋旋轉如何即時補償、3 位元量化與 FX 架構如何決定靈敏度與運算量，再把相位／頻帶校正、時脈分配與端到端驗收整理成可交接的工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using the ALMA 64-antenna baseline correlator and the VLA WIDAR correlator as references, the course explains how visibilities arise from cross-correlating two antennas' voltages, how geometric delay and fringe rotation are compensated in real time, how 3-bit quantisation and the FX architecture set sensitivity and compute load, and then organises phase and bandpass calibration, clock distribution and end-to-end acceptance into a handoff record.
procedure: 相關器把天線 i 與 j 的電壓做時間平均的互相關 ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩，得到複數可見度 V(u,v)；依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理，它是天空亮度分佈在空間頻率 (u,v) = B_proj/λ 上的傅立葉分量。N 台天線同時提供 N(N−1)/2 條基線，地球自轉讓每條基線在 (u,v) 平面上掃出一道弧線，於是影像的解析度由最長基線決定、可偵測的最大角尺度由最短基線決定、視場則由單天線主波束決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

同一波前到達不同天線的時間差 τ_g = B·ŝ/c 隨地球自轉連續改變，相關器必須在相乘之前以整數取樣加分數延遲把它補回來，並以條紋旋轉抵消因延遲變化而產生的自然條紋頻率，否則積分時訊號會自己抵消。殘餘延遲誤差 Δτ 在頻寬 Δν 上造成相位斜率，振幅按 sinc(πΔτΔν) 衰減；時間平均過長則造成視場邊緣的時間塗抹。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每台天線的中頻訊號以 Nyquist 速率取樣後只保留少數位元：ALMA 以 4 GS/s、3 位元數位化 2 GHz 基頻，WIDAR 則提供 3 位元與 8 位元取樣器。粗量化損失的是訊噪比而非線性度，只要門檻相對訊號均方根設在最佳位置，1 位元效率 0.64、2 位元 0.88、3 位元 0.96、4 位元 0.99；自動位準控制讓輸入功率維持在門檻的最佳比例，相關係數再以 van Vleck 修正還原。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「數位化器與量化效率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

FX 相關器先對每台天線做通道化（F：多相濾波器組加 FFT），再對每條基線、每個通道做複數乘加（X）；XF 或滯後式相關器則先相乘再做傅立葉轉換，ALMA 的基線相關器是帶數位濾波器組的混合架構。F 的運算量隨 N 線性成長，X 的運算量隨 N² 成長，兩者之間需要一個把「按天線排列」的資料轉成「按頻率排列」的角落交換網路；CASPER 的開源 FPGA 板與 GPU 的 X 引擎讓新陣列可以快速組出相關器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「F 引擎、角落交換與 X 引擎」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

大氣與儀器把每台天線的訊號乘上一個複數增益 g_i，量到的可見度為 V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij；由於 N(N−1)/2 條基線遠多於 N 個未知增益，閉合相位（三角形相位和）與閉合振幅不受天線增益影響，可用來檢驗資料並做自校正。ALMA 以每隔數分鐘觀測相位校正器加上每台天線的水氣輻射計，把大氣水氣造成的快速相位起伏即時修掉。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「天線增益與閉合量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每台天線的濾波器與數位化器給出自己的複數頻帶響應 B_i(ν)，必須用強而平坦的校正器解出並除掉。通道化本身也有響應：單純 FFT 的通道旁瓣只有 −13 dB，強譜線會洩漏到鄰近通道；多相濾波器組給出平頂通道與 60 dB 以上的洩漏抑制。譜線觀測的頻譜動態範圍由頻帶解的訊噪比、頻帶穩定度與洩漏共同決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「頻帶響應與多相濾波器組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）；任何未修正的光纖相位變化都直接變成可見度相位誤差。相關器輸出以 1–16 s 積分、數千通道的可見度，輸出資料率受封存系統限制，因此積分時間與通道平均要依科學需求與資料率一起設計，時間戳記必須與 UTC 對齊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「頻率參考與資料流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相關器的驗收分三層：板級測試向量、整機滿載運轉，以及上機試觀測——點源影像的動態範圍、流量尺度、頻譜純度、閉合量與每一種觀測模式（通道數、頻寬、積分時間）都要有紀錄。交接給營運單位時要附上模式表、已知限制、校正程序與回歸測試套件，之後每次韌體更新都重跑回歸測試，否則通道順序或相位符號的改變會以影像鏡像或頻譜翻轉的形式出現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相關器驗收與營運交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The correlator forms the time-averaged cross-correlation ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩ of the voltages from antennas i and j, giving the complex visibility V(u,v); by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem this is the Fourier component of the sky brightness at spatial frequency (u,v) = B_proj/λ. N antennas provide N(N−1)/2 simultaneous baselines, Earth rotation sweeps each one along an arc in the (u,v) plane, so the image resolution is set by the longest baseline, the largest detectable angular scale by the shortest and the field of view by the single-dish primary beam. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Visibility and the (u,v) plane”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The arrival-time difference of one wavefront at different antennas, τ_g = B·ŝ/c, changes continuously with Earth rotation, so the correlator must restore it before multiplying, using an integer-sample plus fractional delay, and must apply fringe rotation to cancel the natural fringe frequency produced by the changing delay, otherwise the signal averages itself away. A residual delay error Δτ produces a phase slope across the bandwidth Δν and the amplitude decays as sinc(πΔτΔν); too long a time average smears sources at the edge of the field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Geometric delay and fringe rotation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each antenna's IF is sampled at the Nyquist rate and only a few bits are kept: ALMA digitises 2 GHz basebands at 4 GS/s with 3 bits, and WIDAR offers 3-bit and 8-bit samplers. Coarse quantisation costs signal-to-noise rather than linearity: with thresholds optimally placed relative to the signal rms, the efficiency is 0.64 for 1 bit, 0.88 for 2 bits, 0.96 for 3 bits and 0.99 for 4 bits; automatic level control keeps the input power at the optimum ratio to the thresholds, and the correlation coefficient is restored by the van Vleck correction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Digitiser and quantisation efficiency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An FX correlator first channelises each antenna (F: polyphase filter bank plus FFT) and then performs a complex multiply-accumulate per baseline and channel (X); an XF or lag correlator multiplies first and Fourier-transforms afterwards, and the ALMA baseline correlator is a hybrid with digital filter banks in front. The F cost grows linearly with N while the X cost grows as N², and between them a corner-turn network reorders data from antenna order to frequency order; CASPER's open-source FPGA boards and GPU X-engines let new arrays assemble correlators quickly. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “F-engine, corner turn and X-engine”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Atmosphere and instrument multiply each antenna's signal by a complex gain g_i, so the measured visibility is V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij; because the N(N−1)/2 baselines greatly outnumber the N unknown gains, closure phases (sums around triangles) and closure amplitudes are immune to antenna gains and serve both to check the data and to self-calibrate. ALMA observes a phase calibrator every few minutes and uses a water-vapour radiometer on each antenna to remove the fast atmospheric phase fluctuations in real time. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Antenna gains and closure quantities”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each antenna's filters and digitiser impose their own complex bandpass B_i(ν), which must be solved from a strong flat-spectrum calibrator and divided out. Channelisation has a response of its own: a plain FFT channel has sidelobes of only −13 dB, so strong lines leak into neighbouring channels, whereas a polyphase filter bank gives flat-topped channels with more than 60 dB of leakage rejection. The spectral dynamic range of line observations is set jointly by the bandpass solution's signal-to-noise, bandpass stability and leakage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bandpass and polyphase filter bank”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector); any uncorrected fibre phase change becomes a visibility phase error directly. The correlator outputs visibilities integrated over 1–16 s with thousands of channels, the output rate is limited by the archive, so integration time and channel averaging are designed together with the science case and the data rate, and time stamps must be aligned to UTC. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Frequency reference and data flow”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Correlator acceptance has three layers: board-level test vectors, full-load operation of the whole machine, and on-sky commissioning where point-source image dynamic range, flux scale, spectral purity, closure quantities and every observing mode (channel count, bandwidth, integration time) are recorded. Handoff to operations includes the mode table, known limitations, calibration procedures and a regression suite that is rerun after every firmware update, otherwise a changed channel order or phase sign convention appears as mirrored images or flipped spectra. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 某台天線的位置若錯了數公分，與它相關的所有基線相位會隨時角與頻率變化，影像出現無法用天線增益校正掉的條紋狀假影；因為是基線相關誤差，閉合量也無法消除。
校正器離目標太遠或切換週期太長時，大氣相位在兩次校正之間已經改變，影像模糊、振幅損失，弱源消失；條紋擬合解錯 2π 整數會讓某天線相位對頻率出現錯誤斜率。
pitfallsEn: An antenna position wrong by a few centimetres makes the phases of all its baselines vary with hour angle and frequency, producing striped artefacts that antenna-gain calibration cannot remove; because the error is baseline-based, closure quantities cannot remove it either.

A calibrator too far from the target or a cycle too long lets the atmospheric phase change between calibrations, blurring the image, losing amplitude and erasing faint sources; a fringe-fit solution off by an integer 2π gives one antenna a wrong phase slope across frequency.

related.title: 電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機
related.transfer: 可遷移「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」與「相位校正、閉合量與自校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling" and "Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Radio-telescope low-noise receivers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從取樣量化、延遲補償到 FX 乘加與校正的數位相關器工程；電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機則以從饋源到低溫 HEMT／SIS 前端的雜訊溫度、Friis 級聯、校正與穩定度工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on digital correlator engineering from sampling and quantisation through delay compensation to FX multiply-accumulate and calibration; Radio-telescope low-noise receivers centres on noise temperature, Friis cascade, calibration and stability engineering from feed horn to cryogenic HEMT/SIS front end, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」與「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” and “System noise temperature Tsys”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Radio-telescope low-noise receivers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Gain fluctuations, 1/f noise and the Allan time", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.transfer: 可遷移「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」與「相位校正、閉合量與自校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling" and "Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從取樣量化、延遲補償到 FX 乘加與校正的數位相關器工程；ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列則以5000 公尺高原上 66 座天線的毫米波干涉成像：大氣、天線面形、SIS 接收機、水汽相位校正與相關器為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on digital correlator engineering from sampling and quantisation through delay compensation to FX multiply-accumulate and calibration; Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array centres on millimetre interferometric imaging with 66 antennas at 5000 m: atmosphere, antenna surfaces, SIS receivers, water-vapour phase correction and the correlator, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」與「查南托高原大氣視窗」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「流量、頻寬、指向與基線的誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” and “Chajnantor atmospheric window”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Flux, bandpass, pointing and baseline error budgets", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 電波陣列相關器
history.text: 1946 年 Ryle 與 Vonberg 建成第一台電波干涉儀，Ryle 隨後發展的孔徑合成在 1974 年獲得諾貝爾獎；1970–80 年代 Westerbork 與 VLA 使用數位滯後式相關器，日本野邊山陣列則率先採用 FX 架構。2010 年前後 NRC 加拿大為擴建後的 VLA 建造 WIDAR 相關器，NRAO 為 ALMA 建造可處理 64 台天線、16 GHz 頻寬的基線相關器並於 2012 年在海拔 5000 m 的操作站完成；同一時期柏克萊 CASPER 推出開源 FPGA 板與工具鏈，之後 GPU 的 X 引擎讓 CHIME 等新陣列以商用硬體完成相關運算。
history.textEn: Ryle and Vonberg built the first radio interferometer in 1946, and the aperture synthesis Ryle developed afterwards earned the 1974 Nobel Prize; in the 1970s and 1980s Westerbork and the VLA used digital lag correlators while the Nobeyama array pioneered the FX architecture. Around 2010 NRC Canada built the WIDAR correlator for the expanded VLA, and NRAO built the ALMA baseline correlator handling 64 antennas and 16 GHz of bandwidth, completed in 2012 at the 5000 m operations site; in the same period Berkeley's CASPER released open-source FPGA boards and a toolflow, after which GPU X-engines let new arrays such as CHIME correlate on commercial hardware.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」到「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling" through "End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
